notes.title: New demo Bug Fix!
notes.notes:
We have solved some of the most reported issues of this new version of the demo! Unfortunately, we have rushed things a bit and so there is a minor slip. Nothing serious, we will fix it as soon as possible!



Here you can find all the corrections: 

Furcifel has been slightly strengthened, especially during the second phase. 

we fixed the bug where Zefiro was being thrown away once getting on the elevator.  

the end credits have been fixed. 

in the Arena, the “Leone di Pietra” has been replaced with the “Naiade”.



Here’s the small problem we’ve encountered:



the “Naiade” will stay motionless and it won’t attack the player, but it will let itself be defeated due to a last-minute oversight. We will solve this as well very soon!

notes.title: A NEW SUPER STONEMACHIA DEMO UPDATE!
notes.notes:
It is with excitement that we announce the newest version of Stonemachia's demo, refined and enriched thanks to all your support and feedback during this incredible year and a half!

With this new ‘update’, you'll be able to re-live the first moments of Stonemachia like it's the first time, thanks to a completely revamped tutorial level, an even more dynamic combat system, new mechanics, and much more!





And now a deep dive into all the new features of the new Stonemachia demo!




Overhaul maps and content:

The Sacrigera Fortress tutorial map has been completely revamped with a new progression, new enemies and new secrets!

The Arena is enriched with new enemies and a new special reward that will let you further explore Medhelan and what Stonemachia has in store!




Combat System Overhaul:

Introducing the new Gambetto System, a completely new game mechanic that will allow you to unleash the hidden power of the Angelic Armour and use a range of powerful special attacks that can both damage the protagonist and activate unique abilities if parried in time! (yes, now you can also parry yourself)

Complete Overhaul of the Horse.

Now the Horse is able to pierce enemies, throw its horn and, by using its Gambetto skill, make crosses fall from the sky!

General balance overhaul of all four chess pieces.

Completely re-designed healing system.

Now healing no longer involves multiple vials but a single item that can be recharged by parrying and defeating enemies.




HUD and menus:

We added the option of re-mapping keys for both gamepad and keyboard. This functionality is still a bit broken but we will polish it up in the future.

Revamped dialogue interface and revised the interaction system in general.





To access the new content, select ‘New Game’ from the main menu after downloading the update!


Let us know how your experience went by leaving a review on the new demo page and join us on our Discord server if you would like to test the game in advance or leave us your feedback!

notes.title: STONEMACHIA BIG UPDATE!
notes.notes:
It has already been a month since the last demo and we realised that setting the map so openly might give a misleading representation of what Stonemachia really is.
For this reason, our FOURTH demo introduces the first two real maps of the game: the tutorial map and a part of Medhelan.

In detail this demo will feature:
- the first two maps of the complete game (like a proper demo), which will give an overview about the first hours of gameplay.
- new tutorial is set in the Castello Scaligero, which will feature new enemies, quests and bosses!
- overall game balancing.
- general optimisation.
- the return of the arena mode!

As always, we encourage you to share your feedback on our Discord server in the dedicated demo section!

notes.title: Stonemachia Next Fest Update
notes.notes:
Stonemachia is ready for the Next Fest, are you?
Will you explore the depths of the Medhelan plains or defeat the evil Armored Boar Samael to gain access to the Visconti Castle?
Lots of new additions and updates:

-New maps and bosses

Hope you have fun!

notes.title: Bug Fix!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! A minor update for the Stonemachia Demo has just been released, fixing some of the most common bugs, including:

- When reaching the bottom of the armored boar arena, the map was partially removed.
- The boss Mikaim's entrance only worked in the Italian language.
- The boss Mikaim spammed too many projectile attacks, and some animations were excessively fast.
- The stone griffin would get stuck in certain areas of its arena.
- Improved audio feedback for hits.
- Frame rate capped at 60 fps to prevent crashes and excessive CPU stress.
- The game can now be completed without collecting the angelic sword and shield; the base sword is permanent until a more powerful weapon is found.
- The lock-on reticle has been reduced in size.
